item.title: State Sen. Greg Albritton: Online sales tax lawsuit ‘threatens the fiscal viability of the state’
item.description: MONTGOMERY — An online sales tax lawsuit pushed by multiple cities "threatens the fiscal viability of the state," according to General Fund Budget Committee chair State Sen. Greg Albritton (R-Atmore).The City of Tuscaloosa sued the State in July over how Alabama's online sales tax law is divided up between counties and municipalities. item.title: 'Take a hard stance against any and every targeted attack': Tuberville introduces bill increasing penalties for attacks on law enforcement
item.description: As threats against law enforcement continue to grow across the nation, U.S. Sen. Tommy Tuberville (R-Auburn) has introduced legislation he hopes will provide an increased measure of safety for officers and agents serving in the field. item.title: UAB promotes interim head coach Alex Mortensen to full time
item.description: On Friday, UAB dropped the interim head coach tag from Alex Mortensen's title, naming him the eighth head coach in program history.Mortensen, who has been the team's offensive coordinator since 2022, led the Blazers after Trent Dilfer was fired in October.
